summary:
The review confirms the builder's data fix byte for byte, checked against oracles that are not the builder's own code. No file on the share was written and no box was touched.

The defect is real and exactly 154 files wide. The staged tree still carries InstallShield 5 file obfuscation on fastfile/Tex1-58.FFL, fastfile/ffinfo.txt, 86 .rif files (avp_huds 23, avp_rifs 63), 8 .bik files and FMVs/IntroSound.smk.

What was re-checked:
- The transform: unshield's own unshield_deobfuscate(), called from libunshield.so.1 (unshield 1.6.2), reproduces all 154 builder outputs byte for byte. Sizes are unchanged.
- The reference list: the NakedAVP md5 list, fetched fresh from GitHub, is identical to the repo copy. 145 de-obfuscated files and all 56 files that must stay as staged match it.
- The FMVs: ffmpeg decodes the video and audio of all 9 with no errors, and the frame counts match their headers. The staged originals cannot be opened.
- Missed files: a second whole-tree scan, using a different method from the builder's, finds nothing beyond the 154. Its 2 hits were checked by hand and are false positives.
- The tools: --check and --full-scan pass. Two fresh --build runs are md5-identical to the builder's output. make_table.py re-derives files.tsv with 0 differences.
- The avp.exe claims: re-read with capstone. The two interfaces are IDirectDraw4 and IDirect3D v1. The menus run at a fixed 640x480. The only SetDisplayMode call on the DirectDraw object passes no refresh rate. A cfg that names a listed device with an unlisted mode leaves the mode index at -1.

What I changed:
- Tests (81 now pass): the transform is pinned against libunshield and skips loudly when the library is absent. Every publish path is checked against sharewrite's quoting rules. A damaged or missing share copy must stop the publish.
- README: how to recover from a failed put, what was independently verified, and the records to correct.
- The launcher spec, rewritten in stage-fleetres.py's own terms. As first written it would have produced an id Tech 3 launcher. The FLEETRES verb must also never delete a valid cfg because its own enumeration failed.
- Stale records the builder missed: _patches/README.txt says AvP is 'CLOSED as BLOCKED. Do not touch it.', and lan-multiplayer-status.md makes 'black screenshot' and 'relative-mouse menu' claims. Both were recorded while the game was stuck at its pre-menu assertion.
launcher_changes_needed: NONE needed for 'selectable in game'. Once the data is published, Options > Video lists every DirectDraw mode avp.exe keeps: bpp > 8, w >= 512, h >= 384, in a depth the HAL device can render, at most 100 modes. The review re-read goldsrc-halo-review/probe_{123,145,195,240}.txt. Those probes use EnumDisplayModes with flags 0, as avp.exe does, and on each of the four LCD boxes the NULL-GUID 'Primary Display Driver' lists 1920x1080x16 and 1920x1080x32, 30-42 qualifying modes in all. The render-depth caps have not been measured. The changes below only make 1080p each box's DEFAULT gameplay mode. The menus run at 640x480 whatever is done (verified at 0x491e90).

provisioning/fleetres/fleetres.c: new verb 'FLEETRES.EXE -avpvideo <cfgpath> <w> <h>'. It must accept exactly what avp.exe accepts (0x5593ec, 0x559344, 0x559810).
(1) Build the primary display's mode list the way avp.exe does:
- LoadLibraryA("ddraw.dll") and GetProcAddress "DirectDrawCreate". No static ddraw import.
- DirectDrawCreate(NULL,&dd,NULL), then IDirectDraw::GetCaps. Require DDCAPS.dwCaps & DDCAPS_3D (0x1); avp.exe drops a device without it.
- QueryInterface for IID_IDirect3D {3BBA0080-2421-11CF-A31A-00AA00B93356}, the v1 interface avp.exe uses (verified at 0x5f84f0). Call EnumDevices, take the FIRST device whose hardware D3DDEVICEDESC.dcmColorModel != 0, and read its dwDeviceRenderBitDepth at byte offset 0x9c (DDBD_16 0x400, DDBD_24 0x200, DDBD_32 0x100).
- IDirectDraw::EnumDisplayModes(dwFlags 0, NULL, ctx, cb). Keep (dwWidth, dwHeight, ddpfPixelFormat.dwRGBBitCount) when bpp > 8, w >= 512, h >= 384 and the depth bit is set: bpp <= 16 needs DDBD_16, <= 24 needs DDBD_24, <= 32 needs DDBD_32. Stop after 100 kept modes.
- With no 3D cap or no hardware device the list is EMPTY.
(2) Target bpp: 32 if (w,h,32) is in the list, else 16 if (w,h,16) is, else none.
(3) Target found: build 32 bytes = 16 x 00, le32 0, le32 w, le32 h, le32 bpp. The zero GUID is portable because the loader compares only those 16 bytes. 1920x1080x32 is 00*16 00000000 80070000 38040000 20000000; the reference encoder is provisioning/patches/avp/apply.py avp_video_cfg().
- If the file already holds exactly these bytes, print 'AvP_Video.cfg: 1920x1080x32 unchanged'.
- Otherwise CreateFile CREATE_ALWAYS, write, read back and memcmp, then print 'AvP_Video.cfg: wrote ...'.
(4) No target: write nothing.
- If the list is NON-EMPTY and the file is 32 bytes with an all-zero GUID naming a W/H/BPP not in the list, DeleteFileA it and print 'AvP_Video.cfg: <w>x<h> not offered - removed a cfg avp.exe cannot use; the game will start at 640x480x16'. Here avp.exe matches the zero GUID, finds no mode, keeps mode index -1, and 0x55999c reads W/H/BPP from the 12 bytes before the mode table.
- If the list is EMPTY, never delete: FLEETRES's own enumeration may be what failed.
- Never touch a cfg with a non-zero GUID. The game wrote it for its named-device entry, and FLEETRES cannot see that device's list.
(5) Every other failure (no ddraw.dll, DirectDrawCreate or QueryInterface fails) prints one line and exits 0. Exit 1 only on a read-back mismatch. The verb must never block or abort the launcher.
(6) Build with build.sh as now (-march=i586, no CMOV, msvcrt printf). tests/python/test_fleetres_p5_safe.py and test_fleetres_quoting.py must stay green.
Known consequence, the same trade as every FLEETRES title: a mode picked in Options > Video lasts until the next launch, when the launcher restores the per-box default.

scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py, in the generator's own terms:
(a) TITLES["AliensVsPredator"] = {"new": {"Play Aliens vs Predator.bat": ("avp.exe", None)}, "launch_txt_line0": ("Play Aliens vs Predator.bat", "Aliens vs Predator", "avp.exe")}. The existing payload() then stages FLEETRES.EXE and FLEETRES.BAT, and launch_txt() rewrites the single data line in place, keeping the file's CRLF. Do not hand-edit launch.txt.
(b) new_launcher(): add 'if title == "AliensVsPredator": self.put(path, crlf(NEW_AVP.format(block=CALL)), "%s/%s" % (title, name)); return' BEFORE the GLQuake/Q2/id Tech 3 branches. Without it the title falls through to the final else and gets NEW_IDTECH3: an idtech3_cfg(None) block and +set r_mode arguments on avp.exe.
(c) NEW_AVP, with no parentheses and no & | < > anywhere:
@echo off
rem Aliens vs Predator - fleet launcher.
rem
rem This .bat exists because a desktop shortcut cannot carry arguments, so there
rem was nowhere to run FLEETRES, and every box started gameplay at the engine's
rem built-in 640x480x16.
rem
rem AvP Gold keeps its GAMEPLAY mode in AvP_Video.cfg: 32 binary bytes, a
rem DirectDraw device GUID then width, height and depth. No text writer can
rem produce that, so FLEETRES.EXE -avpvideo writes it from the modes THIS box's
rem primary display offers, and removes a cfg the game could not use. The
rem menus always run at 640x480 whatever the cfg says - that is the engine.
cd /d "%~dp0"

{block}

if exist "%~dp0FLEETRES.EXE" "%~dp0FLEETRES.EXE" -avpvideo "%~dp0AvP_Video.cfg" %FR_W% %FR_H%

start "" avp.exe

exit
(d) tests/python/test_fleetres_staging.py: add sf.NEW_AVP to the template lists in test_every_variable_a_recipe_uses_has_a_fallback and in _all_generated_lines. FR_W and FR_H already have fallbacks.
(e) Then run stage-fleetres.py --check, tests/python/test_fleetres_*.py and scripts/validate-staged-library.py. Publish per the share-writing rules: one file at a time, each verified.
Win9x is not affected: the only Win9x box, .243, is gated off AvP (no MMX, 165 MHz), so a cmd.exe launcher reaches no COMMAND.COM box.

agent/shared/gameres.h: add NO AliensVsPredator rule. AvP_Video.cfg is binary, no GR_OP can write it, and a second writer would fight the launcher. install.reg sets only 'Source Path'. tests/python/test_gameres_mirror.py needs no change. The resulting writers are FLEETRES at every launch and the game itself when a player saves Options > Video, which is deliberate.

Never stage AvP_Video.cfg or User_Profiles\ in the library: the game writes both into its own directory, per box. avp.exe imports CreateDirectoryA and creates User_Profiles\ itself. validate-staged-library.py could FAIL a title tree that contains either.

Records to correct after the hardware test:
- Games-Library/AliensVsPredator/README-FLEET.txt: 'THE STAGED TREE IS BYTE-COMPLETE' and 'THE FAULT IS ON THE BOX' are wrong. That was a size-only comparison.
- Games-Library/_patches/README.txt, which the builder missed: the section 'ALIENS VERSUS PREDATOR -> NO PATCH NEEDED' and line 840 'AliensVsPredator already CLOSED as BLOCKED. Do not touch it.' Replace both with a record of this de-obfuscation: what changed, apply.py, and the backup at _patches/AliensVsPredator/originals-2026-09-29/.
- provisioning/fleetres/PER-TITLE-STATUS.md line 114: 'not staged, CLOSED as BLOCKED'.
- Compat DB rows 'runs, d3d 640x480': AvP never reached its menu anywhere.
- docs/lan-multiplayer-status.md lines 252 and 403, which the builder missed: 'screenshots come back black' and 'relative-mouse menus' for AvP. Both were recorded while the game was stuck at its pre-menu assertion, so neither is measured. Re-record them from the fullscreen test.

Fact for the refresh lane, verified independently: avp.exe's SetDisplayMode call on its DirectDraw object is the one at 0x537511. A byte search finds no other call [reg+0x54] that loads the object [0x852c20]. It is the IDirectDraw v1 form (this, w, h, bpp) with no refresh argument, so Windows applies its default refresh for that mode. For a 1080p LCD gameplay mode that is the persisted 60 Hz.
tests:
python3 -m pytest -rs tests/python/test_patch_avp.py: 81 passed in about 2.3 s, with the share mounted. The builder's version had 71 tests; the suite's tests/pytest.ini (testpaths=python) collects all 81, so bash tests/run_all.sh runs them.

Added by this review:
- test_transform_equals_unshields_own_function (7 cases, including lengths 70, 71 and 72 and a non-zero seed). It calls unshield's real unshield_deobfuscate() from libunshield.so.1 through ctypes, compares the output bytes and the advanced seed, and skips loudly when libunshield is not installed. It closes a gap: the builder's two transform tests compare apply.py with apply.py. Proven discriminating: a period-70 transform fails it.
- test_every_publish_destination_is_one_sharewrite_accepts. All 308 destinations (154 title files and 154 backups) pass sharewrite.py's own share_parts() and smb_quote(). That refusal would otherwise surface part-way through a 141 MB publish.
- test_publish_stops_on_a_share_copy_it_cannot_account_for, for a garbled copy and for a missing one. A re-run after a failed put must STOP with no runner calls. It must not back up damaged bytes as the 'original' and must not overwrite blind.

Checked by hand:
- The share-side tests skip loudly ('SKIPPED LOUDLY: ... NOT verified') when LIB points at a missing path.
- pyflakes is clean on apply.py, make_table.py and the test file.

Tool runs in this review (evidence in .claude/evidence-1080p/build-avp/review/):
- apply.py --check: 154 original, 56 keep matched, rc 0.
- --check --full-scan: 0 other files flagged.
- Two fresh --build runs into scratch directories: complete=True, and all 154 md5s identical to each other and to the builder's ~/.retro-fleet/patch-out/avp. The manifest md5 is still 8191440652a8b5f36bd43d35a7cf182c; I did not rebuild the default directory.
- make_table.py read-only: 0 differences.
- indep_verify.py (libunshield via ctypes, plus the NakedAVP README fetched fresh from GitHub): 0 problems over 210 rows.
- indep_scan.py: 2 hand-checked false positives. Its positive control over the table rows flags exactly the 154.
- ffmpeg 7.0.2 -xerror -map 0 on all 9 FMVs: rc 0, empty stderr, frame counts 809/1000/953/236/728/451/110/440/642.
- apply.py --publish and --install-server were NOT run against the share.
risks: Every patched file keeps its size, so the publish depends on fresh write times: GAMESYNC resumes on size AND mtime. sharewrite.py fails a put whose share mtime is more than 15 minutes from now. Never publish these files by any route that backdates mtimes; smbclient on this NAS has stamped Oct 2007 before.

The publish is 308 puts: 154 backups to _patches/AliensVsPredator/originals-2026-09-29 plus the 154 files. Each put opens its own smbclient session with two vault reads, so it runs a long time; run it detached with setsid. If a put fails, that share file can be left truncated or missing. The next --publish then STOPs on it, which is now pinned by a test. Recovery is one manual sharewrite put of the built file (see README), and the original is already backed up and verified. Because ffinfo.txt is put last, a half-finished tree fails exactly as today.

Boxes do not pick this up by themselves. On a provisioned box the boot-time GAMESYNC is idle, so every box needs GAMESYNC RESET + START after the publish. Use purge + GAMESYNC so the same-size files are guaranteed to be re-copied.
_patches/README.txt currently tells operators 'AliensVsPredator already CLOSED as BLOCKED. Do not touch it.' If it is not corrected alongside the publish, the next person may refuse or undo the fix.

Whether 1920x1080 appears in Options > Video also depends on each box's HAL dwDeviceRenderBitDepth, which has not been measured. The DirectDraw mode lists are measured and do include 1920x1080 at 16 and 32 bpp on all four LCD boxes.
Only gameplay can be 1920x1080: the menus are hard-coded to 640x480 at 0x491e90. How the engine treats 16:9 has not been evaluated and the picture is likely stretched.

A cfg that names a listed device with an unlisted mode makes avp.exe read W/H/BPP from the tail of DDCAPS (mode index -1). Never stage a fixed AvP_Video.cfg. The FLEETRES verb must enforce the DirectDraw and D3D checks, and must not delete a cfg when its own enumeration came back empty.
The 9 FMVs have no published reference md5. They are proven two ways: the same transform reproduces all 145 referenced files, and every frame of video and audio decodes with ffmpeg.

apply.py --full-scan recognises formats by magic and by all-printable text only, so an obfuscated file of an unknown format would not be flagged. A second scan by a different method was run for today's tree and found nothing more. Re-run both if the library copy of this title ever changes.

The recorded 'AvP screenshots come back black' (.133) and 'relative-mouse menu' claims come from a game dead at its assertion. Treat them as unmeasured rather than as reasons to skip SCREENSHOT or UIKEY.
hw_verification_plan:
Preconditions:
- 'apply.py --publish' has run.
- 'apply.py --check' reports patched=154, UNEXPECTED=0 and keep 56 matched.
- 'python3 scripts/validate-staged-library.py' reports 0 FAIL.
- _patches/README.txt has been corrected.

Boxes, in order: .145 (XP, GeForce 8400GS) first, then .123 (XP, HD 3850), .240 (XP, X1600) and .195 (Win7, HD 5450). No reboot is involved.

1. PURGE.
- EXEC taskkill /f /im "avp.exe"
- EXEC cmd /c rd /s /q "C:\Games\AliensVsPredator"
- DIRLIST the parent must show the directory gone.
- Delete the desktop 'Aliens vs Predator.lnk'. This also removes User_Profiles and any AvP_Video.cfg.

2. REDEPLOY. Run GAMESYNC RESET, then GAMESYNC START, and poll GAMESYNC STATUS. It passes only when all three hold:
- failed_files == 0;
- titles_done == titles_total;
- titles_total equals the LIBRARY's title count for that box profile.

3. SPOT-CHECK with DOWNLOAD (never EXEC type):
- fastfile\ffinfo.txt: md5 8011119b8456329457f0872037b22243, starts 'Graphics\Common;Tex1.FFL'.
- fastfile\Tex37.FFL: 53fa29efc83880c9e56f26ab727b1c6e.
- FMVs\logos.bik: eec9102af437d8563d8a5eb01e4bbbb8.
- Two files that must stay unchanged: fastfile\Snd2.FFL 6447697cc0bf026ceac07e58c8e6acb0 and language.txt 10564fea944ef6680191ecc89a4616d5.

4. LAUNCH. Run EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\AliensVsPredator" "avp.exe", or 'Play Aliens vs Predator.bat' once the launcher is staged. logos.bik should now play; UIKEY ESCAPE skips it.

5. EVIDENCE while it runs.
- Take SCREENSHOT 0 first. XP captures exclusive-fullscreen D3D for other titles, and the earlier 'black' AvP frame on .133 was most likely the game dead at its assertion. Only if the frame really is black, fall back to LOGFILE, DISPLAYCFG and a person at the screen.
- DISPLAYCFG get must read 640x480: the designed menu mode, held fullscreen.

6. EXIT. Run taskkill /f /im "avp.exe", then DOWNLOAD C:\Games\AliensVsPredator\LOGFILE.TXT.
- PASS: 'Loaded FastFile:' lines, no 'ASSERTION FAILED', and no 'IntroFont.rim ... not found'.
- DISPLAYCFG get must show the desktop back at 1920x1080. If it does not, set it back before going on; a stranded 640x480 desktop poisons later launchers.
- WINLIST must show no leftover window.

7. MENU, keyboard only (arrows, RETURN, ESCAPE).
- First run: the profile screen. UIKEY TEXT:FLEET, then RETURN.
- Main menu > Options > Video. LEFT/RIGHT steps through (device, mode) pairs labelled '%dx%dx%d', across 'Primary Display Driver' and the named card.
- PASS: '1920x1080x32' or 'x16' appears. Select it and back out so the game saves AvP_Video.cfg.
- If synthetic keys do not reach the menu, a person is needed once. The 'relative-mouse' label in docs/lan-multiplayer-status.md was never measured on AvP.

8. 1080p PROOF.
- DOWNLOAD AvP_Video.cfg: 32 bytes. The first 16 are the chosen device's GUID (all zero for 'Primary Display Driver'), then 00000000 or 01000000, then 80070000 38040000 20000000.
- Start any level (for example Marine, first mission).
- During gameplay DISPLAYCFG get must read 1920x1080, and SCREENSHOT 0 must show the game. This is the fullscreen 1080p proof.
- Exit, and confirm the desktop is restored.

9. LAUNCHER, once the FLEETRES -avpvideo verb and NEW_AVP are staged.
- Delete AvP_Video.cfg and run 'Play Aliens vs Predator.bat'. DOWNLOAD AvP_Video.cfg must be exactly 00*16 00000000 80070000 38040000 20000000.
- A second launch must print 'unchanged'.
- Gameplay must reach 1920x1080 without visiting the menu.
- Optional before the verb exists: UPLOAD ~/.retro-fleet/patch-out/avp-video/AvP_Video-1920x1080x32.cfg as a hand test only, and delete it afterwards.

10. MUST NOT CHANGE.
- avp.exe stays md5 91bb8e752f42d35f594fc06feabd49cf.
- The 56 keep files (Snd*.FFL, common.ffl, *.dat, language.txt), shape_rifs, MPlayer and MPConfig stay byte-identical. DirectPlay LAN and the MPlayer front end are therefore untouched.
- Every AvP box must end on the same patched data, or level .rif files differ between LAN peers.
- Music stays silent without disc 2 (redbook audio). That is expected.

11. PUSH to every other box that has AvP: purge, then GAMESYNC RESET + START, as above. That is every box except .243, which the gate refuses (no MMX). Record the results in the compat DB from the fullscreen observations.
review_notes:
VERIFIED, with oracles independent of the builder's code:
1. All 210 table inputs, re-read from /mnt: size, md5 and raw 16-byte head match files.tsv.
2. All 154 staged originals were run through libunshield.so.1's own unshield_deobfuscate() (unshield 1.6.2) via ctypes. Every output equals the builder's file in ~/.retro-fleet/patch-out/avp byte for byte and keeps its size. So the patched files differ from the originals only by the intended whole-file transform. The builder's manifest.json agrees on every field.
3. The NakedAVP README was re-downloaded from raw.githubusercontent.com (master and main, md5 62b32d33...). Its 201 MD5 lines are identical to provisioning/patches/avp/nakedavp-gold-md5.txt, so the reference is external, not circular. 145 de-obfuscated files and 56 keep files match it, and every upstream entry is covered.
4. The FMVs: ffmpeg 7.0.2 -xerror -map 0 decodes video and audio of all 9 cleanly; the staged originals cannot be opened.
5. The whole tree (561 files, 307 MB) was scanned by a second method: longest byte run, printable ratio and a broad magic table, raw against de-obfuscated. Nothing beyond the 154. Its 2 hits were checked by hand and are false positives: avpgolded.mpi is 'tcp/conc.mpath.com/8000' plus zero padding, and MPlayer/System/install.log is plain text. Its positive control flags exactly the 154.
6. --check, --check --full-scan, two fresh --build runs and make_table.py all pass and are idempotent: identical md5s, 0 table differences.
7. The avp.exe claims, re-read with capstone:
- the IIDs are IDirectDraw4 and IDirect3D v1;
- the mode filter keeps bpp > 8, w >= 512, h >= 384, a DDBD bit, and at most 100 modes;
- the loader compares only the 16 GUID bytes, and a device match with no mode match leaves index -1, so 0x55999c reads the 12 bytes before the mode table (the DDCAPS tail);
- SelectMenuDisplayMode stores 0x280 and 0x1e0 into the mode globals;
- the only SetDisplayMode call on the DirectDraw object is the v1 form at 0x537511 with no refresh argument.
8. No share writes (no AvP file is newer than Sep 20; no _patches/AliensVsPredator), no box touched, nothing committed. There is no game data under the worktree; provisioning/patches/avp is 124 KB of code, md5 lists and 16-byte file heads.
9. --publish uses sharewrite.py 'put <local> <Files/...>' one file at a time. It backs up (verified) before each put, puts ffinfo.txt last, skips already-patched files, stops on the first failure, and never overwrites a different backup.
10. Multiplayer: AvP has no dedicated server here, so --install-server is correctly N/A. DirectPlay LAN is unaffected apart from needing identical data on every peer.

CHANGED (all inside the avp area):
(a) tests/python/test_patch_avp.py, from 71 to 81 tests:
- a libunshield oracle for the transform, skipping loudly without the library;
- a check that every publish destination passes sharewrite's own quoting;
- a publish STOP on a garbled or missing share copy.
(b) provisioning/patches/avp/README.md:
- how to recover from a failed put, and how long the publish runs;
- the independent verification and the reach of --full-scan;
- the stale records to correct.
(c) The report's launcher_changes_needed, rewritten because the original was imprecise:
- As first described, a TITLES 'new' entry would have fallen through new_launcher() to the id Tech 3 template (+set r_mode on avp.exe). A dedicated NEW_AVP branch is now specified.
- The FLEETRES verb now requires DDCAPS_3D, as avp.exe does, and never deletes a cfg when its own enumeration came back empty (the original could delete a valid cfg after a local enumeration failure).
- The rem line's parentheses are gone.
- launch.txt goes through launch_txt_line0.
- The builder missed two stale records: _patches/README.txt ('CLOSED as BLOCKED. Do not touch it.') and docs/lan-multiplayer-status.md (black screenshots and relative-mouse menus, both recorded while the game was dead at its pre-menu assertion).
(d) The outputs and originals arrays were regenerated from the verified manifest.

NOT CHANGED: apply.py, files.tsv, make_table.py and nakedavp-gold-md5.txt. They are correct.

For the orchestrator: CLAUDE.md asks for hard-won findings in retro-3dfx/FINDINGS.md, which is outside this phase's allowed area, so I did not write it. Worth logging:
- 'A size-only diff certified an InstallShield-obfuscated tree as byte-complete.'
- 'A black screenshot of a game dead at a pre-menu assert was recorded as a capture limit.'
